feeds.title: Arne & Carlos Blog
feeds.description: Get first-hand details about all our activities and the only way to get information about our international tour schedule. Be the first to know about new pattern releases, exclusive discounts and special events. Designers, textile artists and authors, are known for their craft books and their original and visually striking designs.

feeds.title: Paper Tiger
feeds.description: I share my current and future knitting projects and patterns as well as snippets of my life here. My name is Dianna and I'm a serial expat, living in central Norway.

feeds.title: Strikkeoppskrift Blog
feeds.description: Knitting blog with a large collection of links to Norwegian and foreign knitting patterns. The blog posts tips on a free knitting pattern. Sometimes it's a new recipe, other times it's a recipe that deserves to be revisited.

feeds.title: Tante er Fortsatt Gal Blog
feeds.description: This is Norway's largest Knitting Blog. Learn more about Norwegian knitting, explore various patters, tutorials, step by step guides and more!

feeds.title: Tusen Ideer
feeds.description: Tusenideer.no was started by knitting enthusiasts in 2019 as a forum for inspiration, yarn joy and dissemination of different types of needlework. It is our desire to share knowledge as well as create commitment and desire to try new techniques, yarns and patterns.

feeds.title: Statistrikk
feeds.description: Statistrikk is a popular science knitting blog that combines the smart with the beautiful, and that does its best to inspire and entertain with knitting statistics and research.My name is Kathrine Frey Frøslie and I am a knitting statistician at Nesodden outside Oslo. When I'm not knitting, I teach statistics at NMBU at Ås.

feeds.title: Two Strands
feeds.description: Blog topic covers Yarn store, Free knitting patterns, Free pattern index and Technique. The Two Strands blog is run by Mary Ann Stephens who is almost always knitting with two strands of yarn, using Fair Isle and Norwegian colorwork knitting techniques.

feeds.title: Linka Neumann Blog
feeds.description: Linka Neumann is run by the couple Waqas Ali and Linka Neumann. Find Tips and tricks for knitters - Wool and yarn alternatives - How to knit the Wilderness sweater.

feeds.title: Kari-Helene Rane Blog
feeds.description: My musings on the crafting and hand knitting world including new knitting pattern releases, customer projects, my current knitting projects and other knitting and craft related stories. I am originally from Norway and moved to the UK in 2002 to study Fashion Designs at Kingston University. I gained a Bachelors Degree in 2005 and has since worked with knitwear. Kari-Helene Rane is a fashion designer creating unique and modern knitting patterns for self publishing as well as for a range of brands and publications.

feeds.title: Karn Knits Blog
feeds.description: This is a place for me to keep track of my projects, with a detailed account of what I'd done, so that I could do it again, if I wanted to. My name is Karen and I've been knitting since I was about five or six years old. I was born and raised in Birmingham, England and now live in Norway.

feeds.title: Britt-Arnhild's House in the Woods
feeds.description: This blog is a recounting of daily activities of travels and knitting. When I don't travel the world, you find me in my garden watching birds and squirrels, tending flowers. Living the family life in Norway and travels around the world.
